output.reason: [ev-628f9c0eccb2] says directly that 0.46.0 removed support for ZooKeeper-based Apache Kafka clusters and for KRaft migration. Both parts are about how Strimzi works with ZooKeeper, since KRaft migration means moving off ZooKeeper. So product-relationship:zookeeper with change type "removed" is the right mapping and does not merge unrelated changes. This decision covers only the subject and change. The evidence does not settle applicability or consequence.
